description: Create a Tineo support ticket after the user explicitly asks or confirms and notify Tineo support by email. Use when the assistant cannot complete a request, a tool fails, or the requested capability is unsupported. Tineo attaches the user's app version, platform, device model and OS version automatically, so do not ask for them or list them as unknown.

attachments.description: Optional image attachments as base64 data URIs.

confirmed.description: Must be true only after the user directly asks to create a ticket or confirms the assistant's offer.

description.description: User-facing explanation of what failed or could not be completed.

failure_context.description: The failed Tineo tool name and its error text, if a Tineo tool failed.

source.description: Why the support ticket is being created.

name: support_ticket_create
title: Create Support Ticket
